intervals.label: commissioning of SIS18 and the ESR
intervals.note: Year precision: the page says the ring accelerator SIS-18 and storage ring ESR were commissioned in 1990; operation continues (HADES Au+Au beam time 2025).
intervals.quote: Commissioning of the ring accelerator SIS-18 and the storage ring ESR

name: SIS18 heavy-ion synchrotron
notes: The SIS18 is the GSI ring that the FAIR page says will serve as the first acceleration stage (with the UNILAC) for FAIR.

circumference.quote: The SIS18 ring accelerator, which has a circumference of 216 meters

summary.plain: SIS18 is GSI's 216-metre ring accelerator that boosts ions from every element up to about 90% of the speed of light. It feeds GSI's experiments and will serve as the injector for FAIR's new SIS100 ring.
summary.technical: SIS18: heavy-ion synchrotron (216 m circumference) commissioned in 1990, fed by the UNILAC, delivering ions to speeds of about 0.9c for GSI experiments (HADES) and, in future, injecting the SIS100.
